def list_divisors(n):
    divisors_list = set()
    index = 1
    while index * index <= n:
        if n % index == 0:
            divisors_list.add(index)
            divisors_list.add(n // index)
        index += 1
    return sorted(divisors_list)

vector<long long> list_divisors(long long n) {
    set<long long> divisors_set;
    long long index = 1;
    while (index * index <= n) {
        if (n % index == 0) {
            divisors_set.insert(index);
            divisors_set.insert(n / index);
        }
        ++index;
    }
    vector<long long> divisors_list(divisors_set.begin(), divisors_set.end());
    sort(divisors_list.begin(), divisors_list.end());
    return divisors_list;
}
